taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: scape 4-7 m.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: plants acaulescent, occasionally suckering.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: rosettes solitary or infrequently cespitose.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves live for years, as in every agave.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: plants occasionally suckering; rosettes solitary or infrequently cespitose.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: leaves spreading to ascending, 40-75(-82) x (4-)8-10(-11) cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: leaves 40-75(-82) x (4-)8-10(-11) cm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: blade linear-lanceolate to lanceolate, rigid.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: margins undulate to wavy, armed, teeth single, well defined, 4-10 mm, (0.8-)1-3(-4) cm apart; apical spine 2.5-4.5 cm.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: blade pale to glaucous or yellowish green to green, not cross-zoned; glaucous grey-green in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: inflorescences narrowly to broadly paniculate, open.

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: lateral branches (6-)8-18, slightly ascending, comprising distal 1/4-1/3 of inflorescence.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: perianth golden yellow; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: anthers yellow, 7-20 mm.

traits.filament_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: filaments pale yellow, (3.2-)3.5-5 cm.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: capsules sessile or short-pedicellate, narrowly oblong to obovoid.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Agave chrysantha: capsules 3.5-5 cm.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kearney and Peebles, Flowering Plants and Ferns of Arizona (1942) p. 205, Agave chrysantha: in the mountains, 3,000 to 7,000 feet, June to August; FNA: flowering late spring-summer.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: capsules ripe August to October, after the summer flowering.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for golden-flowered agave from Flora of North America vol. 26 p. 459: leaves 40-75 cm (leaf_length 0.6) spreading to ascending, a scape 4-7 m (stalk_height 5.5) with 8-18 branches in its distal quarter to third (stalk_head 0.3), 12-21 erect flowers 3.5-6.5 cm long to a cluster, occasionally suckering (pups 2). Flowering once and dying, flower_age, leaf_rate and the pups' timing are estimates (as for every agave); the blade's area is about half its aspect, as on the template.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a broad rosette of rigid, deeply guttered, glaucous grey-green lanceolate leaves edged with dark red-brown hooked teeth and tipped with a long brown spine; in summer, once, a tall stalk with golden-yellow flower clusters near its top.

allometry.note: 0.5 m tall at 15 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
